$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows (editors use it); ignored.

textures.description: The textures to keep in the folder.

defaults.description: Settings for every texture (size, format, pack).

title: ssg.textures.json
description: Declares the library textures a game keeps in a folder (`slop build` writes each as an image plus a `.json` of its size, background and frame grid, and removes the ones no longer declared).

name.description: File name in the folder (without extension); unique. Default: the texture file's own name.

texture.description: A texture name, a path from `textures --all` (Pack/…/File.png), or an asset id.

pack.description: The pack to look in when several have a texture of that name.

size.description: Largest side in pixels, 8–8192: scaled down to fit, never up.

format.description: The image format written: png or webp.

texture.title: Texture
